CONTINUING GUARANTY

THIS CONTINUING GUARANTY (THIS "GUARANTY") IS MADE AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 BY MARTIN R. ODEGAARD, AN INDIVIDUAL RESIDING IN HENNEPIN COUNTY, MINNESOTA (THE "GUARANTOR"), IN FAVOR OF NORTHLAND MERCANTILE BANK, N.A. (THE "LENDER").

RECITALS

A. THE LENDER HAS AGREED TO EXTEND CREDIT TO ODEGAARD MILLWORK, INC., A MINNESOTA CORPORATION (THE "BORROWER"), UNDER A LOAN AND SECURITY AGREEMENT DATED AS OF SEPTEMBER 30, 2026 (THE "LOAN AGREEMENT").

B. THE GUARANTOR IS THE SOLE SHAREHOLDER OF THE BORROWER AND WILL BENEFIT FROM THE CREDIT EXTENDED UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT.

C. THE LENDER IS WILLING TO EXTEND THAT CREDIT ONLY IF THE GUARANTOR EXECUTES THIS GUARANTY.

1. GUARANTY OF PAYMENT.

THE GUARANTOR ABSOLUTELY, UNCONDITIONALLY, AND IRREVOCABLY GUARANTEES TO THE LENDER THE FULL AND PROMPT PAYMENT WHEN DUE, WHETHER AT STATED MATURITY, BY ACCELERATION, OR OTHERWISE, OF ALL OBLIGATIONS OF THE BORROWER UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT, INCLUDING PRINCIPAL, INTEREST ACCRUING AFTER THE COMMENCEMENT OF ANY INSOLVENCY PROCEEDING WHETHER OR NOT ALLOWED, FEES, AND EXPENSES (THE "GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS"). THIS IS A GUARANTY OF PAYMENT AND NOT OF COLLECTION.

2. CONTINUING GUARANTY.

THIS GUARANTY IS CONTINUING AND APPLIES TO ALL GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS NOW EXISTING OR ARISING IN THE FUTURE. IT REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL THE GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS ARE PAID IN FULL IN CASH AND THE LENDER'S COMMITMENTS UNDER THE LOAN AGREEMENT HAVE TERMINATED.

3. MAXIMUM LIABILITY.

THE GUARANTOR'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY UNDER THIS GUARANTY IS LIMITED TO THREE MILLION DOLLARS ($3,000,000) OF PRINCIPAL, PLUS ALL INTEREST ON THAT AMOUNT AND ALL COSTS OF ENFORCEMENT.

4. WAIVERS.

THE GUARANTOR WAIVES: PRESENTMENT, DEMAND, PROTEST, AND NOTICE OF DISHONOR; NOTICE OF ACCEPTANCE OF THIS GUARANTY; NOTICE OF ANY EXTENSION OF CREDIT TO THE BORROWER; ANY REQUIREMENT THAT THE LENDER FIRST PROCEED AGAINST THE BORROWER OR ANY COLLATERAL; AND ANY DEFENSE BASED ON THE LENDER'S ELECTION OF REMEDIES, INCLUDING ANY DEFENSE UNDER MINNESOTA STATUTES SECTION 582.30 OR ANY ANTI-DEFICIENCY LAW.

5. SUBORDINATION.

UNTIL THE GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS ARE PAID IN FULL, THE GUARANTOR SUBORDINATES ANY CLAIM AGAINST THE BORROWER, INCLUDING ANY CLAIM FOR SUBROGATION, REIMBURSEMENT, OR CONTRIBUTION, TO THE GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS, AND SHALL NOT ENFORCE ANY SUCH CLAIM.

6. REINSTATEMENT.

IF ANY PAYMENT APPLIED TO THE GUARANTEED OBLIGATIONS IS AVOIDED OR MUST BE RETURNED, THIS GUARANTY IS REINSTATED AND CONTINUES IN FULL FORCE AS IF THE PAYMENT HAD NOT BEEN MADE.

7. FINANCIAL INFORMATION.

THE GUARANTOR SHALL DELIVER TO THE LENDER A PERSONAL FINANCIAL STATEMENT AND A COPY OF THE GUARANTOR'S FEDERAL INCOME TAX RETURN WITHIN THIRTY (30) DAYS AFTER THE LENDER'S WRITTEN REQUEST, AND IN ANY EVENT ANNUALLY WITHIN ONE HUNDRED TWENTY (120) DAYS AFTER EACH CALENDAR YEAR END.

8. GOVERNING LAW; VENUE; JURY WAIVER.

THIS GUARANTY IS GOVERNED BY THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA, WITHOUT REGARD TO ITS CONFLICT OF LAWS PRINCIPLES. ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF THIS GUARANTY SHALL BE BROUGHT EXCLUSIVELY IN THE STATE OR FEDERAL COURTS LOCATED IN HENNEPIN COUNTY, MINNESOTA, AND THE GUARANTOR CONSENTS TO THE JURISDICTION OF THOSE COURTS. THE GUARANTOR WAIVES ANY RIGHT TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY ACTION ARISING OUT OF THIS GUARANTY.

9. MISCELLANEOUS.

THIS GUARANTY IS THE ENTIRE AGREEMENT OF THE GUARANTOR AND THE LENDER ON ITS SUBJECT MATTER. IT MAY BE AMENDED ONLY BY A WRITING SIGNED BY BOTH. IT BINDS THE GUARANTOR'S HEIRS AND PERSONAL REPRESENTATIVES AND INURES TO THE BENEFIT OF THE LENDER'S SUCCESSORS AND ASSIGNS. IF ANY PROVISION IS UNENFORCEABLE, THE REMAINDER REMAINS IN EFFECT.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, THE GUARANTOR HAS EXECUTED THIS GUARANTY AS OF THE DATE FIRST WRITTEN ABOVE.

/S/ MARTIN R. ODEGAARD
MARTIN R. ODEGAARD, GUARANTOR
